summary.plain: The international team that built and ran the POLARBEAR experiment and its successor, the Simons Array, in the Chilean Atacama.
summary.technical: Collaboration signing the POLARBEAR papers ("The Polarbear Collaboration") and operating the James Ax Observatory telescopes (POLARBEAR-1, POLARBEAR-2/Simons Array).
